verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents its own natural-language surface: the `ai_query` parameter accepts a plain-language description of the information to extract, AI extraction is recommended for semantic fields, and an official MCP server is documented that would let AI agents drive the product. However, the evidence never shows end-to-end natural-language operation of scraping, crawling, scheduling or configuration. Most of the product is still driven by structured parameters and JSON instructions. missing for 10: documented natural-language control beyond extraction (e.g., NL-driven scraping, crawl or schedule commands), details of what the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
